//: stream's bar: tags, layout, mode and the focused window from streamctl watch (jq picks this bar's monitor), then status, clock and tray. Style: waybar.css next to this file.
//tags: Like dwm's tag bar: click views the tag, right click adds it to the view.

custom/tag-1.exec: streamctl watch | jq --unbuffered -c '.outputs[] | select(.name == env.WAYBAR_OUTPUT_NAME) | {text: "1", class: ["tag", (if (.tags | contains([1])) then "focused" elif (.occupied | contains([1])) then "occupied" else "empty" end)]}'

//layout: Like dwm's layout symbol, plus the master count: click goes back to the previous layout, right click is monocle.

custom/mode.exec: streamctl watch | jq --unbuffered -c '{text: (if .mode == "normal" then "" else .mode end)}'
